1. Apprehending arrest in connection with C.R. No.488 of 2023 registered with Shahupuri Police Station, District Kolhapur on 22 nd April 2023 for offences punishable under sections 406, 420,
468, 471 read with section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and section 3 of the MPID Act, the applicant is seeking relief under section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
2. According to the prosecution, the principal accused is the beneficiary of entire amount received from the investors except amount of Rs.600/- received by the applicant as a commission.
According to him, nothing in excess of amount of Rs.600/- per investor is received by the applicant from the principal accused.

sentences.text: Learned APP states that this needs to be investigated.
Hence, at this stage, the applicant needs to be protected by an interim 916-aba1998-2023.doc order.

Hence, following order:
a) Till next date, in the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with C.R.
No.488 of 2023 registered with Shahupuri Police Station, District Kolhapur on 22nd April 2023 for offences punishable under sections 406, 420, 468, 471 read with section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and section 3 of the MPID Act, he be released on interim bail on furnishing PR Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- along with one or two sureties in the like amount.;
b) The applicant shall remain present before the investigating officer on 24th, 26th and 28th July 2023 between 11:00 a.m. to 02:00 p.m.
c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any witness acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer;
d) The applicant shall not obstruct or hamper the police investigation and not to play mischief with the evidence collected or yet to be collected by the police;
e) The applicant shall, at the time of execution of the bond, furnish his address and mobile number to the investigating officer, and the court concerned, and shall not change the residence till the final disposal of the case.
4. Stand over to 9th August 2023.
(AMIT BORKAR, J.)
